displayName: Kev 4B OpenRouter native Choice prompt findings
referenceStatus: Frozen provisional v0.2 development labels; scoring is offline.

nativePromptEquivalence.meaning: P1 and P2 share feedback, policy, criteria, labels, label order, route, and parser. Only each native Choice question instruction differs.
nativePromptEquivalence.wireEquivalence: Native Choice analogues of the prompt conditions; not byte-identical chat prompts.

historicalP0.comparisonScope: Separate descriptive baseline; only clean closed P0 fresh1/fresh2 are eligible.

interpretation.nativeChoiceProbabilities: Full native Choice probability dictionaries are retained and compared separately from categorical answers.
interpretation.vendorConfidence: Provider confidence is retained separately. It is not treated as the chosen-label probability or a calibrated correctness probability.
interpretation.timing: Client-observed request duration includes network and local work; it is not provider inference time.
interpretation.cost: Cost is observed provider cost reconciled against the closed child ledger.
interpretation.repeatPower: Three closed passes describe observed repeat variation for these exact requests. They do not determine performance on new records or another route.
